record.question: Who wrote the book "Marriages and Morals"?
record.explanation: The publisher credits Bertrand Russell. The printed plural Marriages is a source title error; the real title is Marriage and Morals. Historical exam context: 2010-03-24 (full date printed on cover). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.routledge.com/Marriage-and-Morals/Russell/p/book/9780415482882 Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
